advisor_discrepancy.over_counted_reason: extension-owned PostGIS functions; excluded via pg_depend deptype='e'
advisor_discrepancy.under_counted_reason: anon-executable SECURITY DEFINER functions in the exposed sponsor schema; the Dashboard/CLI advisors only report public.*

MOVE_PRIVATE_revoking_execute_breaks_rls.reason: called from RLS policy expressions; pg_policies proves usage; relocate to a non-exposed `private` schema and re-point policies instead of revoking

REVOKE_NOW_trigger_only_wrongly_anon_exe.reason: used only as trigger functions; triggers fire as table owner and do not require EXECUTE

EXCLUDE_extension_owned.also_excluded_by_owner: all functions owned by postgis / vector / pg_trgm installed in public

REVIEW_anon_executable_app_owned.note: remainder of the 36 app-owned public anon-executable functions after removing the 7 MOVE_PRIVATE and the 8 REVOKE_NOW (overlap: none of the 8 are in the 7). Each must be individually justified or revoked in SB-003 Batch 0.
